entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicants have filed this First application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicants have been arrested by Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior in connection with crime No. 75/2022 registered for the offence punishable under Section 420, 409 of IPC and section 66-D of IT Act.

entities.text: Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Prosecution story, in brief, is that a written complaint was made by complainant Ajay Kumar Tandon before police station concerned alleging therein that co-accused Subhash Chandra Jewria,
who is Director of Jewria Services Club India Private Limited & owner of a website crypotokaka.com, asked the complainant to get himself registered on the aforesaid website and invest in Bitcoin Digital Currency.

entities.text: Jewria Services Club India Private Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The complainant is said to have been asked to have more investors registered for better incentives.
On the basis of said assurance, the complainant has invested his money in the wallet of the website.

Thereafter, the withdrawal option has been closed,
thereby, restrained the complainant from withdrawing the invested amount.

On the basis of aforesaid, an FIR bearing Crime No. 75/2022 was registered against the applicants and other co-accused persons at police station Crime Branch, District Gwalior for the offences punishable u/s.
409 & 420 of IPC and section 66 D of the I.T. Act.
Learned counsel for the applicants argued that applicants are innocent persons and have been falsely implicated.
He further argued that applicants are the only earning member of their family.
He further argued that there is delay in lodging the FIR.
He further argued that there is no evidence on record to constitute an offence punishable under section 409 of IPC against the present applicants.
He further argued that main allegations is levelled against the co- accused Subhash Chandra Jewria and his associates.
Nothing on record to show the connection of the present applicants /accused with the crime allegedly committed by the accused persons.
The wife of applicant No. 2 is pregnant.
The applicants are in custody since 01/03/2023.
Investigation is nearing completion and further custodial interrogation of the applicants may not be required.
The applicants are permanent resident of District Gautambudh Nagar (U.P.).
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time and there is no likelihood of their absconsion, if released on bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicants.

On the other hand, learned State counsel as well as counsel for the complainant vehemently opposed the application on the ground that investigation is at its primary stage and on the basis of memorandum of the applicants and seizure thereof, it cannot be said that the applicants are not involved in the crime.
The offence is not registered only under section 409 of IPC, but the same is also registered under section 420 of IPC, section 66-D of I.T. Act r/w section 120-B of IPC.
The factum of conspiracy with the co- accused is apparent.

It is further argued that investigation is going on and after conclusion of investigation more offences may be added, therefore, looking to the nature of offence, prima facie, at this stage, prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
On considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case.
So also, when the NAMDEORAO DURGEKAR Signing time: 21-04-2023 05:46:39 PM investigation is at primary stage, this Court is not inclined to grant benefit of bail to the applicants at this stage.
Accordingly, this first application of the present applicants under Section 439 Cr.P.C. relating to the aforesaid crime is hereby dismissed.
Certified copy as per rules.
